subject: qa/d4-r2-execution-receipt.json
subjectNote: Gate 3 execution receipt (BL-057, route R2). This sidecar is the registered home of the receipt generator's ledger-fence binding; it carries no payload bytes of its own.

ledgerPrefix.semantics: R2 entry-scoped span binding: spanByteOffset is the raw-byte start of the ENTRY 10 heading; spanByteLength extends to the execution-time freeze endpoint (end of the ENTRY 14 region); spanPrefixSha256 is the SHA-256 over raw bytes [0, spanByteOffset + spanByteLength). An end-append preserves the bound prefix; any modification before the endpoint does not.

payloadReference.note: R3 payload/provenance separation: this sidecar is provenance; the payload is the receipt and its executionFingerprint is unchanged by the binding-source migration.

migration.disposition: Re-expressed under CONV-EVIDENCE-BINDING-001 R2 as an entry-scoped span binding; the generator reads this sidecar in place of the literal. The pinned value and the prefix endpoint are unchanged.
migration.rationale: Ledger-named literals are structurally non-allowlistable (scripts/validate-ledger-pins.py); the R2 model replaces the embedded prefix literal with a registered entry-scoped binding verified by scripts/validate-evidence-bindings.mjs.
